headword: {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}
gloss: member of the House of Representatives

definitions.gloss: member of the House of Representatives
definitions.explanation: An elected member of the House of Representatives ({衆議院|しゅうぎいん}), the lower house of the Japanese National Diet. Members serve four-year terms and are chosen through a combination of single-seat constituencies and proportional representation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was elected as a member of the House of Representatives.

examples.japanese: {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四年|よねん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The term of a House of Representatives member is four years, but it can be shortened by dissolution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定数|ていすう}→定数：05149_teisuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧465⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧で、{小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{比例代表|ひれいだいひょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: The current fixed number of House of Representatives members is 465, elected from single-seat constituencies and proportional representation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧ (House of Representatives) and ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧ (legislator, member of parliament). The ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧ is the lower and more powerful house of the ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (National Diet). Often abbreviated to {衆院議員|しゅういんぎいん} in news headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: House of Representatives election
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run for the House of Representatives
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a member of the House of Representatives
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}: former House of Representatives member
